Nominal Mg10Si3O14(OH)4, 35 atoms/formula unit and Z=2. Litasov et al. (2007) infer LT polymorph from synthesis/measurement temperatures, without a full in-situ structural refinement. Independent diffraction model: Koch-Müller et al. (2005) Table 4, MKM0105 Pnn2, with author-corrected O6 and official 2014 H2 erratum. Retain the structure-source a=14.024, b=5.109, c=8.733 Å orientation (a/b exchanged relative to Litasov). This ideal fully occupied structural proxy is not the EOS specimen and is not rescaled to fitted V0. H2 is an IR-derived positional estimate. Distinct from Al-bearing Xu (2024) superhydrous phase B.

Published experimental fit to nominally pure Mg superhydrous phase B. 300 K subset: 17 in-situ plus three ambient observations. Marginal P/T extrema are coverage, not a phase-stability rectangle; nine heating cycles include three outside the stability field. No temperature-dependent Kprime. Weights and covariance of original least squares are not reported.

Parameter covariance is not supplied.

- **Description:** Complete Table 2: SB2-004 through SB2-069 and three recovered ambient cells; Au marker and both pressure reductions.
- **Kind:** pressure\_volume\_temperature\_lattice\_parameters
- **Reference:**
    - **Authors:** Litasov; Ohtani; Ghosh; Nishihara; Suzuki; Funakoshi
    - **Year:** 2007
    - **Source:** Physics of the Earth and Planetary Interiors
    - **Volume:** 164
    - **Locator:** 142–160
    - **DOI:** 10.1016/j.pepi.2007.06.003
- **Source location:** Table 2, pp. 144–145

- **Uncertainty:**
    - **Reported as:** estimated\_standard\_deviation
    - **Covariance:** not\_reported
- **Notes:** measurement\_number 4..69 denotes SB2-004..069. -1,-2 are recovered synchrotron cells; -3 lab XRD. Ambient P=0 GPa and T=300 K are explicit reference-state assignments, not separately printed readings. Blank Au and pressure error remain missing. Source gives same uncertainty for P2 as P1 (shared pressure\_sigma\_gpa). Temperature errors are not tabulated; thermocouple pressure-emf effect not corrected. Au a0=4.0786 Å sets diffraction geometry. All source lattice axes retained, with long b; do not confuse structure-source long a. Table 2 footnote explicitly identifies parentheses as estimated standard deviations.
